label: Early copy phase (2nd-3rd outputs) of long sequences
explanation: Positional unit. Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely on the first two steps after the delimiter (recall_idx 1, when outputting original token 1 with orig(0) as input, and recall_idx 2), and only when the sequence is long (L >= 7, mostly L = 8-9; to_go >= 5). Never fires during the original phase, at the <DEL> step, or for L <= 5. recall_idx 1 carries ~65% of activation mass and the strongest activations; recall_idx 2 is weaker, and recall_idx 3 adds a small tail for L = 9. Magnitude also grows with L (L=9 holds ~64% of mass). Within the positional window, token identity modulates whether and how strongly it fires (e.g. a first token n or v gives the top activations, while many other first tokens give little or nothing), and this is not captured; that causes most of the false positives (precision ~0.69 on dev). There is a tiny tail at the last copy steps of L = 9 sequences.
